purpose: Exercise the Moonshot Reality Compiler across distinct evidence regimes before scaling to the full founder moonshot corpus.

canaries.firstClaim: A learned or generated representation can make at least one held-out problem family materially easier than strong baseline representations without leakage.
canaries.firstProbe: Construct several fixed problem families, hide held-outs, generate competing representations, and measure verified resource/correctness deltas.

canaries.firstClaim: Reusable reasoning operators can be isolated such that composing them yields predictable transfer gains across more than one task family.
canaries.firstProbe: Define a small operator vocabulary and run ablations/compositions under fixed model and token budgets.

canaries.firstClaim: Two heterogeneous real-world capability providers can expose one stable semantic contract without erasing authority, provenance or result semantics.
canaries.firstProbe: Use non-consequential sandbox providers first and verify identical intent/result contracts and explicit provider-specific limits.

canaries.firstClaim: A bounded physical unit or material architecture can reversibly change at least two useful macroscopic configurations under external control with quantified energy/reliability.
canaries.firstProbe: Map existing reconfigurable-material mechanisms and identify one measurable gap before any hardware spend.

canaries.firstClaim: Humans can learn a stable intuitive mapping from a non-native data stream to decisions that transfers beyond memorized training examples.
canaries.firstProbe: Use a noninvasive synthetic signal and compare trained performance, transfer and retention against ordinary visualization.

canaries.firstClaim: A machine-readable bundle of provenance, evidence, authority and accountability can reduce coordination failure in a bounded multi-agent task versus an unstructured baseline.
canaries.firstProbe: Run adversarial simulations with and without the trust bundle, then measure fraud acceptance, false rejection and completion quality.

canaries.firstClaim: A compact bootstrapping package can recursively expand the set of tools it can produce under a bounded simulated resource environment.
canaries.firstProbe: Model a tiny software/manufacturing toy world and minimize the seed set that can regenerate all target capabilities.

canaries.firstClaim: A new substrate should count as possibility-expanding only if it supports a demonstrably new family of composable artifacts rather than one isolated trick.
canaries.firstProbe: Build a retrospective dataset for writing, electricity, digital computation, networking and AI; test metrics that distinguish platforms from isolated inventions.
